$comment: Motion vocabulary. Each signature maps to kit attributes and states its job. The deal picks one signature and two supports; never more than four effects in one viewport.

signatures.job: orchestrated entrance: the headline arrives word by word
signatures.html: Roasted on Tuesday, in your cup by Friday

signatures.job: scroll story: a statement lights up as it is read
signatures.html: We buy from four farms we visit every harvest.

signatures.attrs: data-stack on the list of cards
signatures.job: scroll story: chapters pile up, one covers the last

signatures.attrs: data-scrub (or data-scrub="pinned" inside data-pin) + CSS using var(--p)
signatures.job: scroll story: an object turns, opens, fills or moves with scroll
scroll story: a sideways journey through steps or work

signatures.attrs: data-marquee="60" on a row of items
signatures.job: rhythm: an endless band of names, dates or items

signatures.attrs: data-count on an element whose text is the final number
signatures.job: proof: a real number counts up when seen
reveal: an image or block wipes open once
reveal: items of a list arrive in sequence
depth: a layer drifts slower than the page
delight: the main button leans toward the cursor
signatures.html: Reserve a bag

signatures.job: feedback: a soft light follows the cursor over a panel

signatures.attrs: data-scramble or data-scramble="hover" on short text
data-progress on a thin fixed bar
signatures.job: orientation: how far through a long page you are
